reviews.name: Elaine Bose
reviews.review: I'd like to rate SARAH'S Assisted Living in Wildomar 2 X 5 stars! My 99 year old father, with short term Dementia, said he would NEVER leave his home for Assisted Living EVER. From day one in February 2020 he was the happiest and most content since my mother passed in 2001. The caregivers were responsible for that and I commend them all. Thomas, the owner, and his family were exceptionally caring and compassionate.

reviews.name: Jenni Abecilla
reviews.review: I am very thankful for the care and compassion that the staff at Sarah's Great Life provides for my grandfather. The staff pays close attention to each person's needs, treats everyone like family, and has gone above and beyond my expectations.

reviews.name: Katherine Vaughn
reviews.review: I work for a local hospice agency and this is an amazing board and care. Brandee treats her residents like family and the care goes above and beyond. The home is clean, safe, and in a wonderful neighborhood.

reviews.name: Erin Eastman
reviews.review: My hospice Sonata referred me to this home. It was the perfect balance of homey feeling and proper care for my mother. Brandy, the house manager, was amazing and treated my mother with respect, comfort, love, and tenderness.

reviews.name: Alberto Martinez
reviews.review: Sarah's Great Life was a positive experience for my mother with dementia. The caregivers were attentive, compassionate, and provided excellent care. I am grateful for everything they did.

reviews.name: Heather Tuione
reviews.review: I absolutely love this place. They are so good to my mom and to our family. Brandee, Dee Dee, and Willie are angels. They treat my mom like a queen.

reviews.name: Cindy Nichols
reviews.review: My stepdad moved in early August. The staff is amazing and he is very happy. It feels like home for him and we know he gets 24-7 care. Highly recommend this home.

reviews.name: Michael Bouchard
reviews.review: My sister has been at Sarah's for almost 2 years and she is extremely well cared for. Thomas is kind and caring, and the caregivers go above and beyond to ensure safety and dignity.

reviews.name: Lynne Steele
reviews.review: Highly recommend Sarah's Great Life. Everyone was caring and provided invaluable knowledge in my father's care. Thomas was communicative and responsive. The caregivers were exceptional.

reviews.name: Mary Frost
reviews.review: My dad and stepmom have been there since August 2019. Everything is neat and clean. The caregivers take great care of my 91 year old father with dementia. Very happy I found this caring home.

reviews.name: Donna Heckelsberg
reviews.review: My dad was only at Sarah's a short time but Dee Dee and Brandee gave him amazing care at the end of his life. They were very attentive and compassionate. Beautiful place and staff.

reviews.name: Nico Bimbo
reviews.review: My mother has been here for over a year and a half and loves it. Caregivers are wonderful, the place is very clean, and the food is great.

reviews.name: Barry Santley
reviews.review: The home was comforting, the room was a nice size, and the kindness Dee Dee and Brandy showed my family was the best. Thank you.

reviews.name: Debbie Viers
reviews.review: My mother has been here for nine years. It is so nice knowing she is getting such great care.

reviews.name: John Vasiento
reviews.review: My father has been living at Sarah's for many years. Ownership and staff are friendly and transparent. My dad receives excellent care and everyone has his best interest at heart.

reviews.name: Cindy Zapata
reviews.review: I am extremely grateful for the care my dad received during his 3-year stay. Casandra showed so much love and support. Thank you to Thomas and Brandee as well for everything they do.

reviews.name: Kellie Standing Warrior
reviews.review: I am leaving a raving review for Sarah's Good Life. We needed a safe place for my father after a terrible experience elsewhere. My dad received excellent, compassionate care here and I am so thankful.

reviews.name: Jenny Pereyra
reviews.review: Putting my father in a home was incredibly hard. Hospice recommended Sarah's and from day one I felt peace. The care, professionalism, and kindness were more than we hoped for.

reviews.name: Rosalia Tuihalangingie
reviews.review: Best environment for loved ones. Cassandra is amazing and always ensures residents are taken care of. Very homey environment. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Ruby
reviews.review: Sarah's Good Life is a wonderful place for elderly people. Cassandra is a very hard worker and shows amazing care and love to the residents.

reviews.name: Rayna Haacker
reviews.review: This was the best place for my mom. She loved the owners and staff. She felt safe, loved, and well cared for.

reviews.name: Cindy Woods
reviews.review: From the first time I spoke to Thomas, I knew he was passionate about providing the level of care my mother needed and deserved. Every staff member I encountered at Sarah's Best was compassionate, professional, and attentive.

reviews.name: Christina Bennington
reviews.review: When I had to place my mom in a home for 24-7 care, I wanted the best. After observing many homes, I knew Sarah's Best Life in Murrieta was the right choice. Cozy, wonderful staff, and a caring environment.

reviews.name: Shelly Conti
reviews.review: We had the tough decision to get my mom more care. Sarah's Assisted Living provided quality care that made the transition easier on our family. I am grateful to all the staff for their support.

reviews.name: Sandy W
reviews.review: This place is wonderful. The caregivers are amazing, the facility is beautiful, the meals are delicious, and there are great activities. We definitely made the right choice for my mom. We love Best Life Assisted Living.
